commands.summary: 7/7 correlated bounds unit tests passed: backend justification, numerical status separation, native vs hull monotonicity, all 11 objectives, analytic toy cancellation, fail-closed handling, and artifact generation
Generated correlated_bound_capability.json and hull_loss_validation.json with 10 validation anchors across 3 scales
Verified 214/214 protected files clean and intact

requirement_evidence.evidence: Concrete backend justified: auto-LiRPA CROWN backward linear relaxation with affine zonotope support evaluation on SingletonHeightCNN surrogate. Supported operators: Conv2d, BatchNorm2d, MaxPool2d, ReLU, Flatten, Linear. Verified by test_c01_backend_justification_and_dimensions.

Support and margin bounds derived mathematically: LB_m = <lA_m, x_center> + lbias_m - sum_k |(lA_tail_m)^T B_k| a_k - sum_j |lA_tail_m_j| e_j. Numerical status is separated as CONDITIONAL_REAL_ARITHMETIC. Verified by test_c02_numerical_status_and_margin_derivation.

Exposes CorrelatedBoundMode.NATIVE_CORRELATED and CorrelatedBoundMode.CORRELATED_HULL. Outer-box method_id is strictly labeled 'auto-lirpa-crown-correlated-hull-v1'. Triangle inequality guarantee LB_m^{native} >= LB_m^{hull} verified on all margins without exception. Verified by test_c03_native_vs_hull_monotonicity_and_labeling.

Evaluates all 11 class margins against winner c*. Matches reference identity, checkpoint_sha256, graph_id, and domain_id. Ambient dimensions (768), fixed prefix (384), tail (384), latent (K=8), residual (384) explicitly documented. Verified by test_c04_all_11_objectives_and_identity_binding.

Analytical 2-variable toy network (y = x_1 + x_2, x = [u, -u]^T) demonstrates 100% correlation cancellation (gap = 2.0). Actual paired validation study measures mean hull loss of 149.47 and ~83% cancellation ratio across validation anchors. Verified by test_c05_toy_correlation_cancellation.

Preserves all K=8 latent components and all 384 residual bounds without truncation. Forged anchor receipts and non-finite domain endpoints are rejected fail-closed with FAILED status and ValueError. Verified by test_c06_fail_closed_error_handling_and_no_truncation.

LiRPA adapter and bounds engine updated with non-breaking backward compatibility. All 214 protected files confirmed clean and intact. Artifacts correlated_bound_capability.json and hull_loss_validation.json generated successfully. Verified by test_c07_validation_ablation_and_artifact_generation and week4_audit check.

scientific_dispositions.H07_cancellation_gap: CONFIRMED: Outer coordinate bounding boxes discard cross-coordinate cancellations between PCA eigenvectors and convolutional filters, incurring substantial hull loss (mean ~149.5 margin units).
scientific_dispositions.H08_linear_relaxation: CONFIRMED: Evaluating CROWN backward linear relaxation directly on the affine generators preserves correlation without expanding the bounding box.
scientific_dispositions.H10_pca_affine_domain: CONFIRMED: K=8 PCA basis captures sensor spatial-temporal correlations; affine zonotope evaluation eliminates the wrapping effect on principal components.
scientific_dispositions.H11_correlated_vs_box: CONFIRMED: Native correlated bounds achieve strictly tighter lower margins than outer bounding boxes across all validation anchors (all_paired_comparisons_pass = true).
scientific_dispositions.H22_computational_cost: CONFIRMED: Affine support evaluation overhead is negligible (<0.5ms), while CROWN backward pass remains the latency bottleneck (~800-1300ms).

limitations: CROWN backward linear relaxation remains too slow for streaming real-time certification (~1.3s per anchor vs 2ms inference budget), confirming H21.
Floating-point BLAS roundoff is un-enclosed in CROWN backward passes, requiring CONDITIONAL_REAL_ARITHMETIC status.
